column2: [intro]
I marvel at the buttons on my shirt,
Counting grains of rice on my plate with mirth,
I find treasures in mouse droppings, so absurd,
Futility is my secret world, undeterred.
In the realm of trivialities,
We only speak of the insignificant,
Little things that make us laugh and sing,
Lightness of being is the path we cling.
I collect mismatched socks with delight,
I watch the hypnotic flight of flies in their flight,
I marvel at a tangled ball of yarn in sight,
Trivial things are my guilty pleasures, so right!
In the realm of trivialities,
Forget all your worries and your strife,
We have fun without ever tiring,
In this kingdom, time is not a defining.
[ solo ]
In the realm of trivialities,
We only speak of the insignificant,
Little things that make us laugh and sing,
Lightness of being is the path we cling.
[outro]
